#!/bin/bash -l
#SBATCH --account=m3748_g
#SBATCH --constraint=gpu
#SBATCH --qos=regular
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=4
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=32
#SBATCH --gpus-per-node=4

#SBATCH --exclusive
#SBATCH --time=01:00:00
#SBATCH --job-name=sync-final-comparisons
#SBATCH --output=build/development-sync-cee2ca2fd/comparisons-%j.log
set -eo pipefail
cd "$SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR"
export WARPX_AUDIT_BUILD_NAME=build_pm_gpu_sync
status=0
run_study () {
    local result=0 tag
    tag=$(IFS=-; echo "$*")
    WARPX_AUDIT_STUDY_TAG="$tag" bash \
        Tools/Algorithms/PrescribedFluids/perlmutter_reaudit.sbatch "$@" || result=$?
    printf '%s %s\n' "$tag" "$result" \
        >> "build/reaudit-2026-09-21/suite-$SLURM_JOB_ID.status"
    if [[ "$result" != 0 ]]; then status=1; fi
}
case "${1:?Specify coupled or equal_error}" in
    coupled)
        for solver in Yee PSATD semi_implicit_em semi_implicit_mm; do
            run_study coupled "$solver"
        done
        ;;
    equal_error)
        run_study equal_error
        run_study profile
        ;;
    *) exit 2 ;;
esac
exit "$status"

#!/bin/bash -l
#SBATCH --account=m3748_g
#SBATCH --constraint=gpu
#SBATCH --qos=regular
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=4
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=32
#SBATCH --gpus-per-node=4

#SBATCH --exclusive
#SBATCH --time=01:00:00

set -eo pipefail
cd "$SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR"
source build/reaudit-2026-09-21/perlmutter_gpu_warpx.profile
export MPICH_GPU_SUPPORT_ENABLED=1 MPICH_OFI_NIC_POLICY=GPU
export AMREX_DEFAULT_INIT='amrex.use_gpu_aware_mpi=1'
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MPLBACKEND=Agg
kind=${1:?base or refined}
study="$PWD/build/reaudit-2026-09-21/discharge-$kind-$SLURM_JOB_ID"
mkdir -p "$study"
git rev-parse HEAD > "$study/revision.txt"
git -C build/stock-warpx rev-parse HEAD > "$study/stock-revision.txt"
python3 Tools/Algorithms/PrescribedFluids/record_sources.py "$study/source-sha256.json"
nvidia-smi > "$study/device.txt"
module list > "$study/modules.txt" 2>&1
rank="$PWD/Tools/Algorithms/PrescribedFluids/perlmutter_gpu_rank.sh"
options=(--seeds 1 2 3 4 --refinements base)
if [[ "$kind" == refined ]]; then options=(--seeds 1 --refinements timestep particles joint); fi
status=0
for version in branch stock; do
    build=build_pm_gpu_sync
    if [[ "$version" == stock ]]; then build=build/stock-warpx/build_pm_gpu_sync; fi
    python3 Tools/Algorithms/PrescribedFluids/discharge_convergence.py "$build" "$study/$version" \
        --data "$PWD/build/reaudit-2026-09-21/test-data/warpx-data" \
        --jobs 1 --launcher "srun -N 1 -n 2 -c 32 --cpu-bind=cores bash $rank" \
        "${options[@]}" || status=1
done
exit "$status"

#!/bin/bash -l
#SBATCH --account=m3748_g
#SBATCH --constraint=gpu
#SBATCH --qos=regular
#SBATCH --nodes=2
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=4
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=32
#SBATCH --gpus-per-node=4
#SBATCH --gpu-bind=none
#SBATCH --exclusive
#SBATCH --time=00:45:00
#SBATCH --job-name=sync-expanded-restart
#SBATCH --output=build/development-sync-cee2ca2fd/expanded-restart-%j.log
set -eo pipefail
cd "$SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR"
source build/reaudit-2026-09-21/perlmutter_gpu_warpx.profile
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/build_pm_gpu_sync/lib/site-packages"
export MPICH_GPU_SUPPORT_ENABLED=1 MPICH_OFI_NIC_POLICY=GPU
export AMREX_DEFAULT_INIT='amrex.use_gpu_aware_mpi=1'
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MPLBACKEND=Agg
study="$PWD/build/reaudit-2026-09-21/restart-expanded-$SLURM_JOB_ID"
mkdir -p "$study"
git rev-parse HEAD > "$study/revision.txt"
python3 Tools/Algorithms/PrescribedFluids/record_sources.py "$study/source-sha256.json"
sha256sum build_pm_gpu_sync/lib/site-packages/pywarpx/*.so > "$study/python-library-sha256.txt"
nvidia-smi > "$study/device.txt"
module list > "$study/modules.txt" 2>&1
rank="$PWD/Tools/Algorithms/PrescribedFluids/perlmutter_gpu_rank.sh"
input="$PWD/Tools/Algorithms/PrescribedFluids/benchmark.py"
for seed in $(seq 41 88); do
    output="$study/semi_implicit_mm-seed$seed"
    mkdir -p "$output/full" "$output/restart"
    options=(--mode coupled --mcc-all --beam fluid --ions fluid --cells 32 256
             --max-grid-size 32 --steps 20 --subcycles 2 --solver semi_implicit_mm
             --seed "$seed" --checkpoint --checkpoint-period 10 --snapshot-particles)
    (cd "$output/full" && srun -N 2 -n 8 -c 32 --cpu-bind=cores bash "$rank" \
        python3 "$input" "${options[@]}" > run.log 2>&1)
    (cd "$output/restart" && srun -N 1 -n 4 -c 32 --cpu-bind=cores bash "$rank" \
        python3 "$input" "${options[@]}" --restart "$output/full/diags/chk000010" \
        --check-restored "$output/full/result.npz" > run.log 2>&1)
    printf 'Completed paired seed %s\n' "$seed"
done
python3 Tools/Algorithms/PrescribedFluids/analyze_restart.py "$study"

58779669.script:
#!/bin/bash -l
#SBATCH --account=m3748_g
#SBATCH --constraint=gpu
#SBATCH --qos=debug
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=4
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=32
#SBATCH --gpus-per-node=4
#SBATCH --gpu-bind=none
#SBATCH --exclusive
#SBATCH --time=00:30:00
#SBATCH --job-name=warpx-audit-suite
#SBATCH --output=build/reaudit-2026-09-21/suite-%j.log

# Run independent studies in one allocation while retaining individual status.
set -eo pipefail
cd "$SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR"
status=0
run_study () {
    local tag
    tag=$(IFS=-; echo "$*")
    local result=0
    WARPX_AUDIT_STUDY_TAG="$tag" \
        bash Tools/Algorithms/PrescribedFluids/perlmutter_reaudit.sbatch "$@" || result=$?
    printf '%s %s\n' "$tag" "$result" \
        >> "build/reaudit-2026-09-21/suite-$SLURM_JOB_ID.status"
    if [[ "$result" != 0 ]]; then status=1; fi
}

case "${1:?Specify convergence, noise, restart, scaling, physics or coupled_mm}" in
    convergence)
        run_study convergence joint
        run_study convergence solvers
        run_study convergence deposition
        ;;
    noise)
        for suite in fields push source coupled; do run_study noise "$suite"; done
        ;;
    restart)
        for solver in Yee PSATD semi_implicit_em semi_implicit_mm; do
            run_study coupled_restart "$solver"
        done
        ;;
    scaling)
        run_study scaling
        run_study weak
        if [[ "$SLURM_JOB_NUM_NODES" == 1 ]]; then run_study storage; fi
        ;;
    physics)
        run_study physics float
        run_study dcs
        ;;
    coupled_mm)
        run_study coupled semi_implicit_mm
        ;;
    *) echo "Unknown audit suite: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
exit "$status"
